segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone combination skin reports it is moisturizing, absorbs well, and does not feel greasy, while noting fermented ingredients can cause breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers with sensitive skin (one fair-skinned redhead) report it is lightweight and did not break them out, though a third reviewer without sensitive skin who did break out speculates sensitive skin could react worse.

concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: three reviewers say it does not break them out and one calls it good for acne-prone skin, but one reviewer without typically sensitive skin broke out and suspects an allergic reaction, and another notes fermented ingredients can trigger breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with acne-prone combination skin says it absorbs nicely without feeling greasy.

aspects.libelle: Stings if it gets in eyes

extraits.texte: This broke me out, unfortunately. I was looking for a sunscreen that was fragrance-free, had no white cast, and was lightweight. And this product has all of that, so when I used it, I was shocked when I broke out. I don't really have sensitive skin, so I imagine what this would do to someone with sensitive skin! I looked it up, and it may have been an allergic reaction. Still sucks though, I worked hard for my skin to be clear, just restart the skin care process, because of this sunscreen :(

I have acne prone combination skin so far I love it It's so moisturizing and doesn't feel super greasy on the skin absorbs really nicely no burning no white cast, but beware it does have fermented ingredients so it can cause breakouts.

Love this sunscreen! I am a natural redhead with fair, sensitive skin. I do not like super thick sunscreens, and this product is extremely lightweight and does not break my face out. It also does not have that strong sunscreen smell either.

I have been on the hunt for a spf moisturizer that blends well with makeup, doesnt break me out, has no white cast, an gives me a glowly look. This is the product! Applies super easily and does a great job keeing my skin hydrated throughout the day.

I love this sunscreen it's one of the best one out there it absorbs quickly into your skin not leaving a white cast like most and it leaves a glow which I really like on my skin. The only downside is rubbing your eyes and getting it in your eyes it burns it's annoying.

reserve: Based on only 9 reviews, with limited or no mentions of oily, dry, normal, or mature skin, or of aging and dehydration concerns in depth.
